items.title: This Insurance Stock Just Raised Its Dividend by Over 11%
items.summary: The Hartford Insurance Group raised its quarterly dividend by 12% to $0.67 after reporting Q3 core earnings of $3.50 per share.

items.title: ALL Q3 Earnings Beat on Protection Services Unit Strength
items.summary: Allstate's Q3 earnings beat estimates by 38.8%, fueled by Protection Services growth and higher investment income, despite surging catastrophe losses.

items.title: Aflac Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong U.S. Profit Growth
items.summary: AFL's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates by 35%, fueled by strong U.S. profit growth and lower expenses, despite weaker Japan results and currency headwinds.

items.title: MET Q3 Earnings Beat on Higher Investment Income, Revenues Miss
items.summary: MetLife's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates on higher investment income and business growth, while rising expenses and actuarial adjustments temper gains.

items.title: AIG Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Premium Growth
items.summary: American International's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates by 11.4% on premium growth and higher investment income, despite elevated catastrophe losses.

items.title: Hartford Insurance Group: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Healthcare inflation is pressuring workers' compensation claims across the industry, testing whether Hartford's pricing discipline can protect margins.

items.title: HIG Q3 deep dive: margin discipline offsets competitive growth headwinds
items.summary: Insurance and financial services company The Hartford (NYSE:HIG) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026 as sales rose 3.9% year on year to $7.22 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.50 per share was 10.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Will Property-Liability Underwriting Woes Hurt Allstate's Q3 Results?
items.summary: ALL's Q3 revenues are expected to rise 4.9%, yet Property-Liability underwriting income may plunge 55.7% as earnings are projected to fall 37.1%.
